retrieval_policy: 官方仓库优先；只下载与本阶段直接相关的少量高价值项目；固定 commit；逐仓库记录。

repositories.name: Eagle (LocateAnything/Embodied)
repositories.paper: LocateAnything: Fast and High-Quality Vision-Language Grounding with Parallel Box Decoding
repositories.reuse_status: wrapper/hook 接入，不修改官方源码
repositories.reused_parts: inference worker 协议、PBD 输出 token 约定、visual prompt LoRA 数据管线格式
repositories.borrowed_design: PBD block=6 结构与 hidden-state 映射；Fast/Hybrid/Slow 解码路径；visual_prompt=true 训练转换

repositories.name: MOTIP (Multiple Object Tracking as ID Prediction)
repositories.paper: Multiple Object Tracking as ID Prediction
repositories.borrowed_design: trajectory features + one-hot ID embedding 拼接；current detections 作为 query、trajectory 作为 key/value 的 cross-attention；当前帧目标间 self-attention；K+1 ID 分类（末位为 newborn）；相对时间位置编码；推理 Hungarian 一对一

repositories.name: MOTIP-2 (independent implementation / reproduction)
repositories.paper: Multiple Object Tracking as ID Prediction
repositories.borrowed_design: IDDecoder 层结构（first-layer cross-attn + 后续层 self-attn+cross-attn）、relative temporal embedding、legal-id 分类、Hungarian + 阈值分配、newborn 过滤
repositories.provenance_note: 无法证明由 MOTIP 原作者或官方组织维护；按 independent implementation / reproduction repository 处理，引用层级低于 MCG-NJU/MOTIP

repositories.name: TrackFormer
repositories.borrowed_design: track queries 跨帧传递；输出顺序 tracks + object queries；Hungarian 中强制 track query 与自身 ID 匹配；inactive track 管理与 ReID

repositories.name: MOTR
repositories.paper: MOTR: End-to-End Multiple-Object Tracking with TRansformer
repositories.borrowed_design: track query 由 QIM 更新（self-attn + MLP + 位置更新）；tracklet-aware label assignment；track-disappear 槽位（对应 NO_MATCH 思路）；memory bank 时序注意力

repositories.name: MeMOTR
repositories.paper: MeMOTR: Long-Term Memory-Augmented Transformer for Multi-Object Tracking
repositories.borrowed_design: short-memory fusion + long-memory 指数滑动平均；memory attention (query=当前 track embedding, key/value=long memory)；新 track 用 query embedding 初始化 long memory

repositories.name: SAM 2
repositories.paper: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
repositories.borrowed_design: prompt encoder（点/框/掩码）；per-object memory bank（maskmem features + pos enc）；memory attention + temporal pos enc；对象指针 object pointer；conditioning frames 最近帧优先

repositories.name: ViPT
repositories.borrowed_design: 可学习 visual prompt token 注入视觉主干（shallow/deep）；参考模板与搜索区域共享 prompt 参数；冻结主干只训练 prompt

repositories.name: GTR (Global Tracking Transformers)
repositories.borrowed_design: attention 权重头输出亲和矩阵；按行 softmax 含 unmatched 列；推理 Hungarian + IoU 融合；box 位置编码

repositories.name: CO-MOT
repositories.paper: CO-MOT: Boosting End-to-End Transformer-Based Multi-Object Tracking via Coopetition Label Assignment and Shadow Sets
repositories.borrowed_design: track query self-attention 竞争；训练插入 IoU 最大 FP track 做 hard negative；track 存在性头；memory bank 保存/更新策略

repositories.name: GMTracker
repositories.borrowed_design: 外观点积 + IoU 直接相加的基础亲和

repositories.name: TADN (Transformer-based Assignment Decision Network)
repositories.paper: Transformer-Based Assignment Decision Network for Multiple Object Tracking
repositories.borrowed_design: learnable null-target 槽；几何 additive attention bias；行 softmax + Hungarian

repositories.name: HNCD-MOTR
repositories.paper: Improving local association in end-to-end tracking via Hard Negative Confusion-aware Denoising
repositories.borrowed_design: hard negative 构造（最近框替换、IoU 最大 FP track 插入）；存在性阈值

repositories.name: FDTA (From Detection to Association)
repositories.paper: From Detection to Association: Learning Discriminative Object Embeddings for Multi-Object Tracking
repositories.borrowed_design: 时间相对位置偏置 attention bias；unknown 间 self-attention 竞争；K+1 分类 + Hungarian

repositories.name: GRAE-3DMOT
repositories.paper: GRAE-3DMOT: Geometry Relation-Aware Encoder for Online 3D Multi-Object Tracking
repositories.borrowed_design: pairwise 几何 MLP relation 编码；additive distance attention bias；relation-aware affinity 头

repositories.name: TrackEval
repositories.paper: HOTA: A Higher Order Metric for Evaluating Multi-Object Tracking
repositories.borrowed_design: 官方 HOTA/CLEAR/Identity 指标与 COMBINED_SEQ 聚合；数据格式
repositories.reuse_status: 直接使用官方 evaluator；仅新增内存数据适配层
